description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for the TinySRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication system, including password and configuration management, cryptographic utilities, and system integration functions.

classes.name: t_num
classes.description: Represents a byte-oriented integer with length and data pointer.

classes.name: t_preconf
classes.description: Holds precompiled SRP parameters including modulus and generator in base64 form.

classes.name: t_confent
classes.description: Represents a configuration entry with index, modulus, and generator.

classes.name: t_conf
classes.description: Represents an open configuration file with associated routines.

classes.name: t_pwent
classes.description: Represents a single password file entry with user name, password, salt, and index.

classes.name: t_pw
classes.description: Represents an open password file with associated routines.

classes.name: t_passwd
classes.description: Combines password entry and configuration entry for a user.

methods.name: t_getprecount
methods.description: Returns the number of precompiled SRP parameter sets.

methods.name: t_getpreparam
methods.description: Retrieves a specific precompiled SRP parameter set by index.

methods.name: t_openconf
methods.description: Opens a configuration file from a FILE stream.

methods.name: t_openconfbyname
methods.description: Opens a configuration file by filename.

methods.name: t_closeconf
methods.description: Closes an open configuration file.

methods.name: t_rewindconf
methods.description: Resets the configuration file stream to the beginning.

methods.name: t_getconfent
methods.description: Fetches the next configuration entry.

methods.name: t_getconfbyindex
methods.description: Fetches a configuration entry by index.

methods.name: t_getconflast
methods.description: Fetches the last configuration entry.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with random parameters.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Variant of t_makeconfent, possibly with additional parameters.

methods.name: t_newconfent
methods.description: Creates an empty configuration entry.

methods.name: t_cmpconfent
methods.description: Compares two configuration entries.

methods.name: t_checkconfent
methods.description: Verifies if a configuration entry is valid (prime, safe prime).

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Writes a configuration entry to a stream.

methods.name: gettcent
methods.description: Access routine for system configuration entries.

methods.name: gettcid
methods.description: Access routine for configuration entry by ID.

methods.name: settcent
methods.description: Sets the current system configuration context.

methods.name: endtcent
methods.description: Ends the system configuration context.

methods.name: gettpent
methods.description: Retrieves the next password file entry.

methods.name: gettpnam
methods.description: Retrieves a password entry by username.

methods.name: settpent
methods.description: Resets the password file stream to the beginning.

methods.name: endtpent
methods.description: Closes the password file.

methods.name: t_verifypw
methods.description: Verifies a username and password against the system password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes a user's password in the password file.

methods.name: t_deletepw
methods.description: Deletes a user from the password file.

methods.name: t_tohex
methods.description: Converts binary data to hexadecimal string.

methods.name: t_fromhex
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal string to binary data.

methods.name: t_tob64
methods.description: Encodes binary data to base64.

methods.name: t_fromb64
methods.description: Decodes base64 data to binary.

methods.name: t_random
methods.description: Cryptographic random number generator.

methods.name: t_stronginitrand
methods.description: Initializes the cryptographic random number generator.

methods.name: t_sessionkey
methods.description: Generates session keys from large integers.

methods.name: t_getpass
methods.description: Reads a password from terminal without echo.

methods.name: t_checkprime
methods.description: Checks if a number is prime and safe prime.
